_about: Public-domain Peter Gandolphy (1779-1821), English Jesuit preacher at the Spanish Chapel, London, for the Word Hoard: A Defence of the Ancient Faith (five sermons, 1811, and the full series in 4 vols., 1813), and his two letters to Herbert Marsh on the Bible Society. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 87 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
